verdict: Rocket Lab closed 2025 with record quarterly revenue of $180M, up 36%, and a record $1.85B backlog — but Neutron development and overhead still outran gross profit, leaving a $53M loss, widened by an $11M tax charge.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: Revenue was a record $180M, up from $132M in Q4 2024

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP, diluted)
kpis.note: Basic and diluted; net loss was $53M, vs $52M a year earlier

kpis.label: Backlog
kpis.note: Orders booked but not yet flown or built; up 73% year over year

kpis.label: Cash
kpis.note: Cash and equivalents at December 31, plus $270M in marketable securities

segments.name: Product revenues
segments.note: Spacecraft, satellite components and systems sold — reaction wheels, propulsion, solar power and the Photon spacecraft platform.

segments.name: Service revenues
segments.note: Launch services (Electron and HASTE missions) and mission services — flying and operating things in space for customers. Seven launches flew in Q4, a quarterly record.

opex.name: Research and development, net
opex.note: Developing the Neutron rocket, Electron and spacecraft — up 63% from $48M a year earlier.

opex.name: Selling, general and administrative
opex.note: Running and selling the company — roughly flat versus $40M a year earlier.

takeaways.title: The order book jumped 73%
takeaways.text: Backlog hit a record $1.85B, helped by Rocket Lab's largest single contract to date — $816M from the Space Development Agency to build 18 satellites. Full-year revenue was a record $602M, up 38%.

takeaways.title: Margins keep improving
takeaways.text: GAAP gross margin reached 38.0%, up from 27.8% a year ago, as higher-margin space systems work grows — services revenue alone rose 77%.

takeaways.title: Losses are not shrinking yet
takeaways.text: The net loss was $53M, about the same as a year ago despite 36% revenue growth: R&D rose to $79M as the Neutron program ramps, and an $11M tax charge widened the loss.

oneTimers: Unlike most loss-making quarters, Rocket Lab still recorded income tax: an $11.3M expense widened the net loss from $41.6M before tax to $52.9M.
otherDetail: Other income was $9.4M net: $9.6M of interest income on the large cash pile and $5.1M of other income, partly offset by $5.0M of interest expense and a $0.2M currency loss.
footerNote: Net loss is the filed $52.9M; the loss per share was −$0.09.

sources.label: Official earnings release — Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (SEC EDGAR)
